svg.title: Déjà-vu Town: a floating island where each building is one of Dejavu Moe's projects. 8 buildings, 287 GitHub stars.

g.text: Hi, I'm Dejavu Moe — a curious explorer
Every building on this island is one of
my projects, rebuilt from GitHub daily.
Flag on the roof = shipped releases
287 stars in the sky — one per GitHub ★
